instruction:
Record Two 3D Layers on a Sphere and Export Three Toggle States

Look at `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scene.obj`. It contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named OrbBase, is a smooth polymesh sphere of radius 1.0 BU at approximately 2048 quads (32 latitude x 32 longitude grid with triangle caps at the poles). It has a single default polygroup, no UVs, no polypaint, and no subdivision stack.

Load this OBJ into ZBrush, record two non-destructive 3D Layers on it (Layer A: belt-band depression along z; Layer B: uniform surface noise), and export three OBJs that correspond to these toggle states of the layer stack:

`C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\all_off.obj` both Layer A and Layer B are OFF
`C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\A_only.obj` Layer A ON, Layer B OFF
`C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\all_on.obj` Layer A and Layer B both ON

Write all three files to ``. All three must share identical vertex and face counts.

The three exported OBJs must satisfy:

- Each contains exactly one SubTool named OrbBase, and all three share the same vertex and face counts.
- `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\all_off.obj` matches the input `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scene.obj` vertex-for-vertex within 1e-5 BU.
- `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\A_only.obj`'s displacement from `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\all_off.obj` concentrates in the belt: >=95 % of total displacement energy is on vertices with |z| < 0.15; total in-band energy > 0.01 BU.
- `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\all_on.obj`'s displacement from `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\A_only.obj` covers the OFF-band region: at least 50 % of vertices with |z| >= 0.15 show displacement > 0.005 BU.
- Mean per-vertex Laplacian of `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\all_on.obj` is at least 1.5x that of `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\A_only.obj`.
- Each of the three meshes is manifold.
